about_the_game:
DEWAZMA

A forgotten mirror. A familiar voice. A past long buried returns to knock on the walls of the present.

Enter a nightmare where the line between dream and reality dissolves, and every familiar space becomes a prison of the mind.

A Mind Unraveling

Dewazma plunges you into the deteriorating consciousness of Rameen, a man trapped between waking and sleeping, between memory and madness. What begins as a simple evening quickly spirals into a psychological labyrinth where nothing can be trusted—not your surroundings, not your memories, and certainly not your own perception of reality.

Experience a world where familiar spaces transform into infinite corridors of terror, where mirrors reflect more than they should, and where the voices of loved ones carry messages that chill the soul. In Dewazma, the most ordinary moments become gateways to extraordinary horror.

The Cycle of Forgotten Pain

Some wounds run deeper than flesh—they carve themselves into the very fabric of family legacy. As Rameen's reality fragments, you'll witness how trauma echoes across generations, manifesting in ways that defy explanation. The past isn't just remembered here—it lives, breathes, and demands acknowledgment.

Navigate through shifting environments that respond to psychological states rather than physical laws. Watch as childhood homes become infinite mazes, as loving voices turn sinister, and as the boundaries between self and shadow blur beyond recognition.

Shattered Reflections

In Dewazma, mirrors are more than glass—they are gateways to memories that refuse to stay buried. Ancient artifacts carry the weight of forgotten sins, and family heirlooms become conduits for forces that transcend understanding. Every reflection tells a different story, and not all of them are meant for mortal eyes.

As you delve deeper into Rameen's fragmented psyche, you'll encounter mysterious languages written in symbols that predate human civilization, paintings that change when observed, and voices that echo from times long past. The very architecture of reality bends to accommodate the weight of suppressed memories.

The Endless Loop

Some nightmares don't end when you wake up—they follow you. Experience a horror game where progress isn't always forward, where familiar locations become labyrinths of psychological terror, and where the simple act of taking medication becomes a choice between clarity and madness.

Navigate through:

• Infinite corridors that challenge your understanding of space and time

• Shifting office spaces that transform into something far more sinister

• Ancestral locations where past and present converge in terrifying ways

• Otherworldly entities that communicate through fear itself

• Phone calls from the past that reveal more than they should

The Weight of Memory

Every family photograph tells a story, but not all stories are meant to be pleasant. In Dewazma, you'll discover that forgetting is sometimes a mercy, and that some memories carry consequences that span generations. The harder you search for answers, the more you'll question whether ignorance might have been the kinder path.

Experience a narrative where spiritual forces intersect with psychological trauma, where ancient languages carry modern curses, and where the simple act of remembering becomes an act of survival. Some doors, once opened, can never be closed again.

Multiple Paths, One Destination

Dewazma offers multiple pathways through Rameen's deteriorating psyche, each revealing different facets of a truth too complex for linear storytelling. Your choices—or lack thereof—will determine not just what you discover, but whether you'll be able to live with the knowledge.

Will you take the medicine that brings clarity, or will you let the nightmares consume what's left of sanity? Will you face the entities that lurk in the shadows, or will you run from truths that demand acknowledgment?

Some cycles can only be broken by understanding them completely.

But understanding comes with a price that may be too high to pay.

"Some doors should never be opened. Some mirrors should remain covered."

content_descriptors.notes: Dewazma includes intense psychological horror, disturbing audio, and terrifying visual elements. Players could encounter discomforting environments, light blood effects, and scenes involving fear, trauma, and distress. The game does not include any sexual content, drug use, or any self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 6600 / Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 6GB / RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 8700 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 Ti / RX 6700 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Dewazma is a psychological horror experience that draws from generational trauma, spiritual mystery, and the darkness we carry within. Step into Rameen's world, where silence speaks, time loops, and the truth waits in the shadows. Face what was lost. Or be consumed by it.
supported_languages:
English*, Arabic
*languages with full audio support
